clubs.name: National Technical Honor Society (NTHS)
clubs.description: The National Technical Honor Society (NTHS) recognizes students who demonstrate excellence in community service and academic achievement. The purpose of NTHS is to promote the value of career in healthcare, engineering, computer science, graphic arts, and business while providing students with opportunities for personal and professional growth. NTHS members engage in service projects, tutoring, and skill development activities that prepare them for future careers.
